classification: Portable publication of recorded synthetic evidence, not a new measurement.
transformation_policy: Numeric observations retained. Host-specific locations made relative or redacted in JSON; native campaign manifest paths rewritten for repository-root execution. Exact bytes retained for numeric inputs, compact sample output and full warm evidence. Observer per-call duration lists and original large sample files omitted. Original artifact digests preserve provenance; recorded source fingerprints are historical, not current-source identity. Serial numeric input line endings restore the LF transport hashed by the original profiler; original Windows CRLF file digests are retained.
